- Where a non-resident's work was performed ENTIRELY outside Colombia the income is foreign-source, was not withheld, and is not reported here at all (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019).
- Numeral 34 must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 - DIAN cross-checks a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer.
- Numerals 30, 31, 35 and 36 are NOT payroll fields - VAT and collaboration-contract identifiers, owned by the client's tax function.

Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA worker type 12 (lectiva) or 19 (productiva).
Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158).

IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix.
The universal Colombian rule - payment o credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000013 of 2021 art. 3), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276.
Numeral 34. Must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 - this is where DIAN cross-checks a dependant claimed twice.

COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE AT PMI: the client master data has no type-code field - it stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Indentity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID). The engine must hold an explicit Employee.Document_Type, derived once from the populated column through a client-confirmed mapping, with a priority rule where more than one column is filled (14 of 261 master-data rows). POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not in the current master-data snapshot - their document type and number must be retained after termination. At PMI 8 persons paid in the year and absent from the master data have no identification number in any mapped report; their identity must be sourced before build. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (the client's accumulators carry a separate 'Beneficiary National Id', mostly on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment - to be confirmed with RA. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.

COMPOSITE FIELD. The resolution names one numeral; the technical specification splits it into four columns - first surname, second surname, first given name, other given names - in the same order as every other DIAN artefact. Sub-field order matters: DIAN matches on the surname columns. SOURCE AT PMI: first surname = master-data Last Name; second surname = Second Last Name (blank allowed); first given name = First Name; other given names = Middle Name (blank allowed). Do NOT use the formatted full name. The four name parts must be retained for leavers and for employer-paid pensioners, who are not in the current master-data snapshot.

COMPOSITE FIELD - department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) of the beneficiary, on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE AT PMI: the client stores a letter department code and a free-text city, so the system must hold the beneficiary's DIVIPOLA department and municipality codes as master data (or convert through a maintained mapping table validated against DIVIPOLA); free text must never be sent. The value for a beneficiary whose address is outside Colombia must be confirmed against the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (RA). Location must be retained for leavers and employer-paid pensioners.

Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator: at PMI that indicator also marks vacation pay and per diems, which belong to numerals 12 and 13. Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36 and must equal it for the same employee and year.

Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20): legal service bonus (prima de servicios), vacation pay (enjoyed, compensated in cash, or paid on termination) and work clothing. Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification; a wage type classified here must be excluded from numeral 5 even where it is flagged as salary in payroll (at PMI vacation pay and the vacation bonus carry the salary flag). Whether extralegal bonuses (e.g. vacation bonus, March/Christmas/August bonuses) are reported here or in numeral 5 / 17 must be fixed per wage type and confirmed with RA. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.

Per diems for transport, subsistence and accommodation away from the habitual workplace, fed by the per-diem wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification (at PMI: hotel, breakfast, lunch and dinner per diem). These wage types carry the payroll salary flag at PMI; the routing of salary-type (permanent) per diems - numeral 13 or numeral 5 - must be confirmed with RA, and each amount reported in one numeral only. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 43.

Non-reimbursable or forgiven educational support from the State or financed with public funds. Res. 227 para. 7 draws the line by WHO ADMINISTERS IT: where the EMPLOYER pays it directly it is reported here; where a THIRD PARTY administers it, it is reported in Format 5247 under concept 5102 instead. Par. 7 was added by Resolution 188 of 2024 art. 8 and, under para. 5 of art. 1.3.9.1.3, first applies to tax year 2025, filed in calendar 2026.

Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (non-salary allowances and bonuses, payments in kind to third parties for the employee's benefit, equity-based compensation, termination indemnities and similar), fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary; in-kind and informative wage types (paid to third parties or abroad) must be explicitly classified - at PMI the 'Inf.' and foreign-paid wage types need a decision per wage type, confirmed with RA. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.

THE SECOND OF THREE. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen fund by 14 February under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 49 - NOT casilla 48. The second and third severance lines are TRANSPOSED between the two artefacts, and a positional mapping swaps them.

THE THIRD OF THREE. Severance RECOGNISED under the pre-1991 retroactive regime, for employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the Law 50 of 1990 regime. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 48 - NOT casilla 49.

Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: at PMI the employer pays company pensions directly (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), so this numeral is NOT nil for this client and the pensioner population (not present in the employee master data) must be included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification; whether lump-sum retirement payments and pension-related compensations belong here or in numeral 17 must be confirmed per wage type with RA. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.

The beneficiary's own mandatory health contributions actually deducted in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the employee EPS contribution wage type (at PMI WT 2554), taken from the contribution wage type itself - never from a combined EPS+AFP+FSP total. Whether health contributions deducted from employer-paid pensions (at PMI the pensioner EPS wage types) are reported here for pensioner records must be confirmed with RA. Maps to Form 220 casilla 53 and must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE163 and to the employee portion of PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 55.

Pension AND the solidarity-fund surcharge (both the solidarity and the subsistence sub-accounts) in ONE numeral, exactly as Form 220 casilla 54 combines them. Source: the employee AFP contribution wage type plus the FSP wage type (at PMI WT 2556 + WT 2553), never a combined EPS+AFP+FSP figure. Whether the solidarity deduction on employer-paid pensions is reported here must be confirmed with RA. The electronic payroll and PILA both keep pension and FSP separate, so the engine must sum only at this point.

Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55. DISTINCT from numeral 26. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the configuration attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)'. At PMI the voluntary pension deductions (the '(FVOL)' provider wage types 25811-25815 and 25823, and the institutional-plan wage types 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803 and 65804) and the APV total in the withholding working report do not carry this distinction - the client must classify each wage type before build. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.

Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the configuration attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. At PMI the candidates are the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804); employer contributions to institutional plans and employee contributions must be told apart (65803 and 65804 are payment / bonus entries whose employer- or employee-side nature is not evidenced in the reports - client to confirm), and each wage type classified by the client before build. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.

Ahorro para el Fomento de la Construccion: the employee's AFC contributions withheld through payroll in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the AFC deduction wage types (at PMI one wage type per bank, 'AFC <bank>'), summed across banks. Treatment of AFC reimbursements / reversals (at PMI 'Reimbursement AFC') must be confirmed with RA. Maps to Form 220 casilla 57 and to electronic payroll NIE179.

THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding actually practised on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted (at PMI the candidates are the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards; in the September withholding working report the 'with contribution' column equals the income-tax wage type for 255 of 261 employees and the 'Theoretical' withholding wage type for the other 6, 5 of them on integral salary). Notional, theoretical or hypothetical tax-equalisation amounts are included ONLY if they were actually withheld and declared on Form 350 - each wage type to be confirmed with the client and RA. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
Populated by the client's tax function where non-deductible VAT attached to the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.
(client tax function)
Populated by the client's tax function where VAT was withheld from the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.

INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8, which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' (at PMI the candidate is 'Meal Allowance Inf.' - client to confirm it is paid to a food supplier).

XML prepared to the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4. DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1 lists the format in its formats-y-especificaciones-tecnicas table as entry T3.45, version 4.

Educational support paid DIRECTLY by the employer goes to numeral 16; support administered by a THIRD PARTY goes to Format 5247 concept 5102. Added by Resolution 188 of 2024 art. 8; first applies to tax year 2025, filed in calendar 2026 (art. 1.3.9.1.3 para. 5).
Deposited to the fund by 14 February under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99. FORM 220 CASILLA 49 - NOT 48.
Colombian employment income carries no VAT. Relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the ET art. 383 table. Owned by the client's tax function.

Where the employer pays a natural person work income that does NOT arise from an employment, legal or statutory relationship, report it HERE if it was withheld under ET art. 383 (art. 383 para. 2, added by Law 2277 of 2022 art. 8, using the payments mensualizados method). Where art. 383 withholding did NOT apply, report it in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead - not here.
Where one is claimed, this must be byte-identical to Form 220 casillas 79 and 80. It is where DIAN cross-checks a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer.
Colombian employment income carries no VAT. Relevant only for a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the art. 383 table; owned by the client's tax function.
DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 arts. 1.3.7.1.1 and 1.3.10.1, both held locally.
